items.title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
items.overview: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

items.title: The Girl with the Leica
items.overview: The love story of Gerda Taro and Robert Capa.

items.title: The Runner: Versenyfutás az életért
items.overview: A „The Runner - Versenyfutás az életért" című pszichothrillerben Maia Marten (Gal Gadot), egy zseniális londoni ügyvéd életét feje tetejére állítja egy telefonhívás reggeli kocogása közben: a fiát elrabolták. Hogy visszakaphassa, futnia kell, kegyetlen utasításokat követni, és közben nem bízhat senkiben - minden másodperc annak próbája, milyen messzire menne el egy anya, hogy megmentse gyermekét.

items.title: No Rest for the Wicked
items.overview: Follows a fisherman who falls in love with a rugged whaler in the isolated Faroe Islands.

items.title: Ghost School
items.overview: Ten-year-old Rabia wants to know why her school has suddenly closed. Rumours are rife in the village and the authorities are no help. Courageously setting out to find the truth, Rabia navigates rural superstitions, local corruption and a wall of silence.

items.title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
items.overview: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

items.title: Same Sun - Mit dem Fahrrad durch Afrika
items.overview: The film SAME SUN tells the story of Wiebke Lühmann's journey from Freiburg to the Cape of Good Hope. Honest, raw, and close to the inner and outer challenges of a 430-day bicycle trip. Her journey takes her through 22 countries, Sahara storms, the rain season, the Congo Basin, and the deserts of Namibia.

items.title: Elephants in the Fog
items.overview: In a small Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest populated by wild elephants, Pirati is the matriarch of a Kinnar community. She dreams of escaping to a “normal” life with the man she is in love with. But when one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility to her community.

items.title: Low Expectations
items.overview: At the height of her music career, Maja falls apart and has to step away from her ambitions. Depressed and broke, she moves back home with her mother and works part-time at a local high school. Far from the spotlight, wrapped in everyday kindness, she slowly finds her way back to life.

items.title: Mother and Me
items.overview: Casey is a young woman confined to her home, living under the same roof as her mother. Struggling to write what’s poised to be a best-selling horror novel and living in the shadow of her late father, a renowned horror author, Casey grapples with the complexities of her relationship with her mother.

items.title: The Room Below
items.overview: After losing her son to cancer, a grieving mother living with a mysterious creature in her home befriends another boy to replace her dead son. But when a retired detective begins investigating the child's disappearance, her carefully constructed world starts to unravel.

items.title: Sara Bareilles: Good Grief
items.overview: Follows Grammy winner Sara Bareilles as she records her first album in seven years with close friends and fellow musicians, creating compositions that emerged from profound personal loss and grief.

items.title: Trapped in the Spotlight
items.overview: Neveah, a canceled R&B singer, struggles to rebuild her career and regain her fame 15 years after breaking up with her estranged co-star, Lupita, who publicly betrayed her.

items.title: Magey Bituge Wedding
items.overview: The most chaotic love story ever!

items.title: The Girl in the River
items.overview: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote Mississippi town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister.

items.title: cocoon - One Summer of Girlhood
items.overview: San and Mayu are two schoolgirls living in Okinawa during the closing months of the Pacific War. Together with their classmates, the two friends are drafted into the war effort as nurses for wounded soldiers. When ordered to die for their country, the remaining members of the group escape only to face the harsh environment of a tropical paradise that has become a hellish battlefield.

She dreams of escaping to a “normal” life with the man she is in love with. But when one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility to her community.
